_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Yaa ngone Golf (Kart Ginnaaw) - Kóko {player_id}.
Jëfandikoo: Ajjëlëëlë totalu ñaareelu ci arafu benn ronde. Su kulum yu bari ñaareelu ñu ngone, ñu nekk ci 0.
Wàllu Kart: A=1, 2-10=wàll, J/Q=10, K=0

Ci tontu (jëfandikoo bekk-brackets):
- '[draw]' - Ci ndawul deck
- '[take]' - Ci ndawul pile bu ñàkk
- '[swap X Y]' - Ci ndawul kart ak position X (ràng) Y (kulum)
- '[discard]' - Ci ñàkk kart bi

board.drew:
Yaa ndaw: {card}
Léegi yaa ngone [swap X Y] mbaa [discard] moom.
board.took:
Yaa jël: {card} ci pile bu ñàkk
Yaa ngone [swap X Y] ak moom (manu ñàkk).

options.final_turns: Tournées yi ñaare! Njëriñ yi: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Danga war a: [swap X Y] (bu mënul sànni ay kaar yu nekk ci daara)

message.deck_empty: Géej gi dafa jeex ba tey.
message.knocked: Jëfandikukat {pid} dañ koo tëj ! Képp jëtun ci yeneen yi am na benn yoon.
message.final_round: Kóko {pid} {reason}! Kóko béle nekk na ci benn tur.

reason.all_revealed: am na ay kaar yu ñu feeñal yépp?

invalid.wrong_action: Jëfandiku ak jëf jëmm ci biiru brackets bi: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], walla [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: Géej gi ñu sànni dafa wéet!
invalid.must_draw_first: Ndaw màm ngone [draw], [take], [knock], walla [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Mënuloo sànni kaar-dëgg bu ñu jële ci ndab li ñuy sànne. Dangaa war koo soppi.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Yaa am kartu ndawul. Yaa ngone [swap X Y] mbaa [discard] moom.
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Dafa soxla ab kaarê bu ñu leen di soppi.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Dafa soxla ab kaarê bu ñu leen di sànni.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Posisyon bi dikk na. Jëfandikoo liggi 1-{max_row}, kolu 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Mënuloo tënk ak kaar-dëgg bu ñu la jël. Jëf sa wàll bi jëkk a mat sëkk.
